key.text: I want to record a podcast episode with two friends about campus food. We need microphones and a quiet room.

output.summary: Record a podcast episode with two friends about campus food using a quiet room and microphones.

needs.why: You need microphones and a quiet room to record the podcast.

ways_considered.process: Borrow wireless and studio microphones with an audio interface
ways_considered.reason: The lab has microphones and recording gear you can check out.

ways_considered.process: Reserve and use the podcast studio
ways_considered.reason: The lab has a dedicated podcast studio with headsets and a mixer.

routes.process: Reserve and record in the podcast studio
routes.fit_reason: This is the easiest option because the room comes fully equipped with multiple microphones and recording gear.

steps.title: Prepare the plan
steps.detail: Write down your questions and what you want to talk about with your friends.

steps.title: Reserve the room
steps.detail: Contact the staff to book the podcast studio.

steps.title: Record your episode
steps.detail: Go to the studio with your friends and record your conversation.

warnings.issue: The podcast studio seats four people.
warnings.fix: Make sure your group does not exceed four people.

routes.process: Check out microphones and recording equipment
routes.fit_reason: This allows you to record your podcast in a quiet location of your choice using portable microphones.

steps.title: Prepare your request
steps.detail: List the microphones you need for your group.

steps.title: Contact staff
steps.detail: Email the staff to arrange equipment checkout.

steps.title: Collect and use
steps.detail: Pick up the gear, record your episode, and return the equipment on time.

warnings.issue: Portable equipment must be returned after use.
warnings.fix: Keep track of all cables and microphones so nothing gets lost.
